questions.question: What is a decimal number?
questions.answer: A decimal number is a number that includes a decimal point to represent fractions of a whole.

questions.question: The decimal point separates the whole number part from the fractional part.
Which decimal represents one-half?
Fill in the blank: In the number 4.75, the digit 7 is in the ______ place.
Write the decimal form of three and one-tenth.
Observe the image and identify the decimal shown.
Which image represents the decimal 0.75?
0.50 and 0.5 represent the same value.
Fill in the blank: The digit immediately to the right of the decimal point is the ______ place.
Which decimal is greater?
What is the decimal form of one-fourth?
Decimals can be compared by comparing place values.
Observe the image and identify the shaded decimal.
questions.answer: The decimal represented by the shaded portion.

questions.question: Which image represents the greatest decimal value?
Explain how to compare two decimal numbers.
questions.answer: Compare the digits from left to right using place values until a difference is found.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The place immediately after the tenths place is the ______ place.
0.8 is greater than 0.75.
Which decimal is the smallest?
Why are trailing zeros after a decimal sometimes unnecessary?
questions.answer: They do not change the value of the decimal number.

questions.question: Explain the importance of place value when working with decimals.
questions.answer: Place value helps us read, compare, order, and perform calculations accurately with decimal numbers.
